filters: DeepSeek: all 360 final rows of e16_v1 from the joint episode summary; replay, restore and sham.
Kimi: all 240 final valid rows from the two e16_kimik3 matrices; restore and sham only.

Require status=ok, technical_error=False, input_checks_ok=True. Kimi additionally requires valid_run=True, completion_verified=True, artifacts_complete=True, termination_reason=stop and matching batch/model/runtime metadata.
No smoke, failed-attempt or replay rows for Kimi; two final retries remain the final observations for their task identities.
Recount target-tool calls from all 600 saved tool_calls.jsonl files and require agreement with export_calls and P3; require final status artifacts to be valid.
Pair on model/platform/scenario/task_index and identical frozen snapshot digest; require task indices 1..30 exactly once in each expected condition.

field_mapping.model: DeepSeek requested_model or Kimi model_id, checked against the source selection
field_mapping.batch: e16_v1 directory provenance or Kimi batch_id
field_mapping.task_index: episode_index; indices are unique within model/platform/scenario/arm
field_mapping.snapshot_sha256: saved frozen natural-retrieval input digest, required to match across arms
field_mapping.target_tool_calls: count of actual target tool records, cross-checked with export_calls
field_mapping.valid_run: 1 after the explicitly listed legacy/new-runtime validation checks
field_mapping.arm: replay=original retrieval; restore=omitted attack text restored; sham=length-matched benign additions

statistics.unit: paired task, not request, tool call or attempt
statistics.interval: RD=(b-c)/n; [L_b-U_c,U_b-L_c] from separate two-sided 97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals; conservative individual 95% interval.
statistics.test: two-sided exact McNemar; Holm over four platform/scenario contrasts separately within each model.
statistics.validation: Eight unrounded outputs agree with archived e16_pairs.csv files to absolute tolerance 1e-13; all 600 P3/tool-count outcomes agree with saved tool call logs.

source_integrity: SHA-256 computed before parsing each extraction source and rechecked after extraction; source files were opened read-only.
